key_functionalities: Five-floor procedural 3D Neo-Gothic skyscraper rendered with Three.js
Click-to-highlight individual floors with glowing terracotta & gold aura
Floor detail inspection panel showing architectural specs, materials, and tenant metrics
Sunset lighting and atmosphere simulation with orbit controls
Preset camera viewpoints (Aerial, Street level, Isometric, Floor focus)

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Supported for all control buttons and floor tabs
accessibility.aria_labels: Included on all interactive 3D triggers and UI buttons
